licence.scope: NASA Science Data Licenses statement (owner's data terms, step 2): data from a NASA-led mission, including calibration data, is CC0 unless the file carries a restrictive notice. It covers NASA mission data in general; the MI filter curve page itself was not found to carry its own notice. Same record as Cassini__ISS_NAC. SVO cites https://mars.nasa.gov/mer/mission/instruments/mi/ (now redirects to https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-exploration-rovers-spirit-and-opportunity/science-instruments/); the MI calibration report is in the PDS Geosciences MER archive. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: Regardless of the license, users are encouraged to cite the original source of the data and the usage of the repository when appropriate.
